topics.name: Hobbies
facts: 'jouer' = to play; 'je joue' = I play; 'je vais jouer' = I am going to play.
'faire' = to do; 'je fais' = I do; 'j'ai fait' = I did.
'lire' = to read; 'je lis' = I read; 'j'ai lu' = I read (past).
'sortir' = to go out; 'je sors' = I go out; 'je suis sorti' = I went out (uses être).
Use 'jouer à' for sports/games (je joue au foot) and 'faire de' for activities.
Key opinion phrases: j'adore (I love), j'aime (I like), je préfère (I prefer), je n'aime pas (I don't like), je déteste (I hate).
'génial' = great; 'ennuyeux' = boring; 'passionnant' = exciting; 'nul' = rubbish.
'la natation' = swimming; 'la lecture' = reading; 'le vélo' = bike.
'écouter' = to listen; 'regarder' = to watch; 'télécharger' = to download.
Adjectives agree: 'intéressant' (m) / 'intéressante' (f).

topics.name: My town and area
facts: 'il y a' = there is / there are; 'il n'y a pas de' = there isn't / aren't (use 'de' after a negative).
'Dans ma ville' = in my town.
'la ville' = town/city; 'le quartier' = neighbourhood; 'le bâtiment' = building.
'la piscine' = swimming pool; 'le parc' = park; 'le musée' = museum; 'le stade' = stadium.
'la boulangerie' = bakery; 'le magasin' = shop; 'le supermarché' = supermarket.
'habiter' = to live; 'j'habite' = I live; 'je vais habiter' = I am going to live.
'aller' = to go; 'je vais' = I go / I'm going.
Adjectives: 'beau' = beautiful; 'joli' = pretty; 'propre' = clean; 'sale' = dirty; 'historique' = historic.
After plural nouns use 'des', not 'un/une': 'il y a des magasins' (not 'des magasin').
'on peut aller au parc' = you can go to the park.

topics.name: Celebrations
facts: 'l'anniversaire' = birthday; 'Noël' = Christmas; 'Pâques' = Easter; 'l'Aïd' = Eid.
'la Saint-Valentin' = Valentine's Day; 'la fête des mères' = Mother's Day; 'la fête des pères' = Father's Day.
'célébrer' = to celebrate; 'je célèbre' = I celebrate; 'j'ai célébré' = I celebrated.
'fêter' = to celebrate/party; 'organiser' = to organise; 'préparer' = to prepare.
'porter' = to wear; 'je porte' = I wear; 'j'ai porté' = I wore.
Food/drink: 'un gâteau' = cake; 'des bonbons' = sweets; 'des biscuits' = biscuits; 'des boissons gazeuses' = fizzy drinks.
Clothing: 'une robe' = a dress; 'une veste' = a jacket; 'un costume' = a suit/outfit.
Adjective agreement: 'joyeux' (m) / 'joyeuse' (f); 'animé' (m) / 'animée' (f).
'magique' = magical; 'incroyable' = incredible; 'magnifique' = magnificent; 'bizarre' = strange.
Use 'Pour mon anniversaire' = For my birthday, to start a sentence about celebrations.

topics.name: Opinions and sentence building
facts: 'parce que' = because; 'car' = because/for; 'mais' = but; 'et' = and.
Intensifiers: 'très' = very; 'assez' = quite; 'vraiment' = really; 'un peu' = a bit.
Higher-level phrases: 'Je dirais que...' = I would say that...; 'Étant donné que...' = Given that...
Positive adjectives: intéressant, amusant, délicieux, génial, magique.
Negative adjectives: barbant, inutile, terrible, fatigant, cher.
'j'adore' = I love; 'je préfère' = I prefer; 'je n'aime pas' = I don't like.
Adjectives must agree with the noun: 'c'est amusant' (m) but 'c'est amusante' is WRONG when referring to 'c'est' (use masculine 'amusant').
Use 'de'/'d'' after a negative: 'il n'y a pas de parc' (not 'pas un parc').
After 'j'aime' use the infinitive: 'j'aime jouer au foot' (not 'j'aime joue').
'le weekend' = at the weekend; 'l'année prochaine' = next year.
